svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: Five technical limits
svg.desc: Five numbered technical limits, describing five things it does not do. First, pure TUN mode is not handled: it listens on no local port, so there is no port to judge, and all traffic already goes through it in that mode. Second, system proxy settings are not modified, because that would affect browsers and other programs; only user-level environment variables are written. Third, already-running programs are not changed, because a program reads the environment variables once at startup, so windows already open need one Enter press. Fourth, tools that need their own proxy configuration are out of scope, because they do not read these variables. Fifth, no interface is provided, because zero dependencies is the install premise.

g.text: Five technical limits: what it does not do
Pure TUN mode is not handled
It listens on no local port, so there is no port to judge; all traffic already goes through it.
System proxy settings are not modified
That would affect browsers and other programs. Only user-level variables are written.
Variables are read once at startup, so windows already open need one Enter press.
Tools needing their own proxy config are out of scope
They do not read these variables. Maven, Gradle and Docker need separate setup.
Zero dependencies is the install premise. Only a menu: no tray icon.
